items.rule: Store numeric amount and ISO currency code separately; never hardcode currency into numeric value.

items.baseline: SI units by default; include common local units only with explicit conversion.
items.rule: Show unit beside every measurement; preserve exact source units and conversion formula.

items.baseline: Asia/Dhaka, 24-hour display as user preference; store timestamps with timezone/offset.
items.rule: Do not infer date from device locale alone; handle DST/time-zone changes even if Bangladesh currently uses one national time zone.

items.baseline: Bangla (bn) and English (en) supported; user can switch per content.
items.rule: Keep stable IDs and technical source names; do not translate code, API identifiers or standard acronyms.

items.baseline: Bangladesh official numbers are sourced but must be rechecked before release. Current evidence in this research pass: 999 general emergency; 102 Fire Service; 1098 Child Helpline.
items.rule: Display jurisdiction, source, last-verified date and offline warning. Verify all numbers with official agencies before release.

items.baseline: Bangladesh regulator/consumer sources and BDT examples.
items.rule: No individual investment advice; legal/tax content requires current Bangladesh professional review.

items.baseline: Avoid assuming one curriculum, school calendar or exam structure.
items.rule: Make curriculum mapping configurable; examples may reference NCTB only when a specific match is verified.
Do not assert law from a draft, news summary or third-party tracker; record exact act, section, gazette and verification date.

items.baseline: Phone-first, intermittent mobile data, optional offline mode.
items.rule: No core task requires video streaming, always-on sync or large downloads.

items.baseline: Use familiar Bangladesh contexts without stereotyping or assuming all users live in Dhaka.
items.rule: Allow region-specific examples and avoid exposing exact home/school locations.
